Forex volatility led to higher translation losses; management is monitoring the Middle East crisis.

operating_notes.text: PFC Consulting Limited is the Bid Process Coordinator for TBCB transmission schemes; it incorporates SPVs to run survey, land acquisition and forest clearance before transferring them to the successful bidder.

Western Ghats PSP Transmission Limited and Hingoli West Power Transmission Limited were incorporated as wholly owned subsidiaries of PFC Consulting to build 400 kV GIS Igatpuri/Murbad and 400 kV AIS Hingoli West stations, to be transferred
Stage 3 loans were ₹6,322.58 Cr at 31 March 2026 with 86.17% impairment coverage, against ₹10,516.85 Cr and 80.10% a year earlier.
CRAR was 23.44% and the debt-equity ratio 4.75 times at 31 March 2026 (standalone).
Board reserved proposal for merger of REC into PFC for the approval of the President of India.
FY26 sanctions were ₹2.85 lakh Cr, of which only about ₹80,000 Cr was disbursed.
Stage-3 book was ₹6,323 Cr across 19 projects at FY26-end, with 86% coverage; 10 projects worth ₹5,469 Cr were under NCLT.
PFC had sanctioned around ₹16,000 Cr towards battery and pump storage projects.
Transferred subsidiary NERGS III Siang Basin Transmission Limited for ₹19.71 Cr.
Transferred subsidiary Kurnool IV REZ Power Transmission Limited for ₹20.94 Cr on May 29, 2026.
Transferred Tumkur II RE Transmission Limited (SPV for 1.5 GW RE integration transmission system) to Power Grid Corporation of India Limited for ₹15.46 Cr.
PFC Projects Limited, formerly Coastal Karnataka Power Limited, was struck off by the RoC with effect from 1 June 2026 under Section 248 after DIPAM withheld approval for new business.
SEBI's observation letter on the REC merger is conditional on RBI approval and settlement of outstanding dues by the listed entities.
Incorporated Solapur SEZ Power Transmission Limited and Karur REZ Power Transmission Limited as wholly owned subsidiaries of PFC Consulting Limited.

timeline.summary: On 30 April 2026, PFC said PFC Consulting Limited incorporated five wholly owned SPVs — Jam Khambhaliya REZ, Lakadia A, Lakadia C, Ananthpuram and Krishnagiri REZ Transmission — to prepare RE evacuation transmission schemes for tariff-based bidding, to be transferred to the winning bidder.
On 7 May 2026, PFC announced that its subsidiary PFC Consulting incorporated Fatehgarh II Transmission Limited as an SPV for transmission projects.
On 8 May 2026, PFC announced that its subsidiary PFC Consulting incorporated Pune West Power Transmission Limited as an SPV for transmission projects.

On 8 May 2026, PFC said PFC Consulting incorporated two wholly owned SPVs — Western Ghats PSP Transmission (400 kV GIS Igatpuri/Murbad) and Hingoli West Power Transmission (400 kV AIS Hingoli) — for transmission projects to be transferred to successful bidders.
On May 13, 2026, Power Finance Corporation reported Q4FY26 standalone PAT of ₹6,325 Cr and recommended a final dividend of ₹3.95 per share.
PFC board reserved the proposal for the merger of REC into PFC for the approval of the President of India.
On 13 May 2026, PFC's investor meet transcript guided FY27 loan growth at ~10% and spread at 2.40-2.50%, and targeted the PFC-REC merger for 1 April 2027.
On May 26, 2026, PFC completed the transfer of its subsidiary NERGS III Siang Basin Transmission Limited for ₹19.71 Cr.
PFC completed the transfer of transmission subsidiary Kurnool IV REZ Power Transmission Limited for ₹20.94 Cr.
On 29 May 2026, PFC completed the transfer of its Tumkur II RE Transmission Limited SPV to Power Grid Corporation of India Limited for ₹15.46 Cr.

On 2 June 2026, PFC said its wholly owned subsidiary PFC Projects Limited was struck off by the Registrar of Companies with effect from 1 June 2026 under Section 248, after Ministry of Power and MCA approvals.
On October 15, 2026, Power Finance Corporation announced the receipt of RBI's no-objection certificate for the proposed merger with REC Limited.

On 19 October 2026, PFC received no-objection letters from BSE and NSE for the proposed merger of REC Limited into PFC, valid six months for filing with NCLT and conditional on RBI approval and settlement of outstanding dues.
PFC Consulting incorporated Solapur SEZ Power Transmission Limited and Karur REZ Power Transmission Limited as wholly owned subsidiaries.
